title: Survival Reworked
description: This mod adds many custom ores, tools, armor sets, and items to the game
body:
Survival Reworked
Ver: 1.0.2

Survival Reworked is a mod that adds new content to the game and new goals so minecraft doesnt get boring as fast, it also adds new items that add a unique touch to the game while still feeling balanced, but getting them wont be easy. Have fun!

In this mod it adds:

Many custom ores with their respective sets of tools and armors (excluding prismasteel)
10+ custom items
5+ custom food item
And much more!

NOTE: You need to use fabric along with the fabric API to use this mod

This mod is compatible and recommended to be used with other mods

ALOT MORE WILL BE ADDED IN THE FUTURE, THIS IS JUST A PRE-ALPHA TESTING PHASE, NOT A FINISHED BUILD SO EXPECT BUGS
